user.title: Add a spice2x machine
user.description: Enter the connection details for the spice2x host. These match the settings you use in the spice companion app.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the machine running spice2x.
data_description.port: API port spice2x was launched with (default 57300).
data_description.password: API password (leave blank if none is set).
data_description.name: Friendly name shown for this machine in Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host, port, and that spice2x is running with its API enabled.
error.invalid_auth: The host rejected the connection. Check the password.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The host and port do not match the machine being reconfigured.

data_description.name: A label for this card, e.g. a player's name.
data_description.pin: The PIN entered after the card is inserted.

data_description.pin_delay: Warm-up wait after inserting a card before the PIN is entered.
data_description.double_stagger: Delay between the two PIN entries when inserting two cards.
data_description.screen_quality: JPEG quality of the mirrored screen (1-100).
data_description.screen_divide: Downscale factor for the mirrored screen (1 = full resolution).

abort.no_cards: There are no cards to remove.

insert_card.name: Insert card
insert_card.description: Insert a card on a player side and enter its PIN.

pin.name: PIN
pin.description: The PIN to enter after insertion.

pin_delay.name: PIN delay
pin_delay.description: Seconds to wait before entering the PIN.

insert_double.name: Insert two cards
insert_double.description: Insert cards on both player sides and enter both PINs.

side.name: Primary side
side.description: The player side of the first card.

pin_delay.name: PIN delay
pin_delay.description: Seconds to wait before entering PINs.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.description: Seconds between the two PIN entries.

keypad_write.name: Write keypad
keypad_write.description: Send keypad input (digits / button presses) to a player side.

screenshot.name: Screenshot
screenshot.description: Trigger a screenshot on the host.

button_press.name: Press buttons
button_press.description: Write raw button states to the host.

lights_write.name: Write lights
lights_write.description: Write raw light states to the host.

touch.name: Touch
touch.description: Write touch points to the screen.

points.name: Points
points.description: List of [id, x, y] touch points.

ids.name: IDs
ids.description: List of touch IDs to release.

control.name: Control
control.description: Run a control action on the host.
